topography.project_purpose: Options. Structurally: 17 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 2 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc165, epochcontrols, erc721enumerable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
